mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( user_login_id, user_name, user_nickname, user_pw, user_birth_date, user_phone, user_email ) VALUES( #{userLoginId}, #{userName}, #{userNickname}, #{userPw}, #{userBirthDate}, #{userPhone}, #{userEmail} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET user_login_id = #{userLoginId}, user_name = #{userName}, user_nickname = #{userNickname}, user_pw = #{userPw}, user_birth_date = #{userBirthDate}, user_phone = #{userPhone}, user_email = #{userEmail} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user WHERE user_login_id = #{userLoginId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} AND deleted_at IS NULL
